subject: english-literature
title: Where the Story Lives
welcome_lead: Big ideas live in worlds. Let's chart both.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on theme and setting basics.
final_note: You can now name a story's central idea and its world.

concepts.def: The big idea a story explores.
Where and when a story happens.
The feeling created by a scene.
The era or moment of the story.
The mood built by setting details.

walkthroughs.body_html: A theme is a big idea: love, conflict, identity, growing up. It's not the plot but the meaning behind it.
Setting = place + time. 'A dark London alley in 1888' tells you both.
A stormy moor builds dread; a sunlit garden builds calm. Writers pick setting details to deepen mood.

mcqs.q: Which of these is a theme?
